wording: Reflective self-modelling provides functions not fully reproduced by simpler task-specific error detection or externally supplied confidence.

decision_rule.retain_if: S2 exceeds every preregistered bypass (S4, H_ERROR and H_EXTERNAL) by >=0.10 mean accuracy or utility on both decisive held-out families and at least 18/20 seeds favour S2 over every bypass.
decision_rule.restrict_if: S2 exceeds the task-specific and world-only bypasses but an information-equivalent external-confidence bypass remains within 0.05 on one decisive family.
decision_rule.reduce_if: H_EXTERNAL remains within 0.05 of S2 on both decisive families and reproduces the misinformation-independent downstream control benefit, showing that access to calibrated self-relevant information rather than endogenous generation is sufficient for the registered function.
decision_rule.reject_if: A simpler non-self or task-specific bypass reproduces the full decisive cross-family profile without access to calibrated self-relevant information.
